# Ezekiel 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-was in-the-thirtieth year, in-the-fourth [month], on-the-fifth of-the-month, and-I [was] in-the-midst-of the-exiles by-the-river Chebar — the-heavens were-opened and-I-saw visions-of God.

**2** On-the-fifth of-the-month — it [was] the-fifth year of-the-exile-of King Jehoiachin —

**3** The-word-of YHWH came, yes-came, to-Ezekiel son-of Buzi, the-priest, in-the-land-of [the]-Chaldeans by-the-river Chebar; and-the-hand-of YHWH was upon-him there.

**4** And-I-looked, and-behold, a-wind-of storm coming from-the-north, a-cloud great and-fire flashing-back-and-forth, and-brightness to-it all-around, and-from-its-midst like-[the]-gleam-of amber, from-the-midst-of the-fire.

**5** And-from-its-midst [was the]-likeness-of four living-creatures; and-this [was] their-appearance: [the]-likeness-of a-human [was] to-them.

**6** And-four faces to-each-one, and-four wings to-each-one of-them.

**7** And-their-feet [were] feet straight, and-the-sole-of their-feet [was] like-[the]-sole-of [the]-foot-of a-calf, and-sparkling like-[the]-gleam-of bronze burnished.

**8** And-hands-of a-human [were] under their-wings on-their-four sides; and-faces and-wings to-the-four-of-them.

**9** Joining each-one her-wings to-her-sister; they-did-not-turn in-their-going — each to-the-direction-of his-face they-would-go.

**10** And-[the]-likeness-of their-faces: [the]-face-of a-human, and-[the]-face-of a-lion to-the-right to-the-four-of-them, and-[the]-face-of an-ox from-the-left to-the-four-of-them, and-[the]-face-of an-eagle to-the-four-of-them.

**11** And-their-faces and-their-wings [were] spread-out from-above; each [had] two joining each-to-the-other, and-two covering their-bodies.

**12** And-each to-the-direction-of his-face they-would-go; to wherever the-spirit would-go, they-would-go — they-did-not-turn in-their-going.

**13** And-[the]-likeness-of the-living-creatures — their-appearance [was] like-coals-of fire burning, like-[the]-appearance-of torches; it [was] going-back-and-forth between the-living-creatures, and-brightness [was] to-the-fire, and-from-the-fire went-forth lightning.

**14** And-the-living-creatures were-running and-returning like-[the]-appearance-of the-lightning-flash.

**15** And-I-looked at-the-living-creatures, and-behold, one wheel [was] on-the-earth beside the-living-creatures for-[each of]-its-four faces.

**16** The-appearance-of the-wheels and-their-workmanship [was] like-[the]-gleam-of beryl, and-one likeness to-the-four-of-them; and-their-appearance and-their-workmanship [was] as-if a-wheel were in-the-midst-of a-wheel.

**17** Upon their-four sides in-their-going they-would-go; they-did-not-turn in-their-going.

**18** And-their-rims — height [was] to-them and-dread [was] to-them, and-their-rims [were] full-of eyes all-around to-the-four-of-them.

**19** And-in-the-going-of the-living-creatures, the-wheels went beside-them; and-in-the-lifting-of the-living-creatures from-upon the-earth, the-wheels were-lifted.

**20** Upon wherever the-spirit would-go, they-would-go — there the-spirit [was directed] to-go; and-the-wheels were-lifted alongside-them, for [the]-spirit-of the-living-creature [was] in-the-wheels.

**21** In-their-going, they-would-go, and-in-their-standing, they-would-stand; and-in-their-lifting from-upon the-earth, the-wheels were-lifted alongside-them, for [the]-spirit-of the-living-creature [was] in-the-wheels.

**22** And-[the]-likeness over-the-heads-of the-living-creature [was] an-expanse, like-[the]-gleam-of crystal, the-awesome-one, stretched-out over their-heads from-above.

**23** And-under the-expanse their-wings [were] straight, each-one to-the-other; each [had] two covering this-side and-each [had] two covering that-side of-their-bodies.

**24** And-I-heard the-sound-of their-wings like-[the]-sound-of many waters, like-[the]-voice-of Shaddai, in-their-going — [the]-sound-of tumult like-[the]-sound-of an-army; in-their-standing they-let-down their-wings.

**25** And-there-was a-voice from-above the-expanse which [was] over their-heads; in-their-standing they-let-down their-wings.

**26** And-from-above the-expanse which [was] over their-heads, like-[the]-appearance-of a-stone-of sapphire, [was the]-likeness-of a-throne; and-upon [the]-likeness-of the-throne [was] a-likeness like-[the]-appearance-of a-human upon-it from-above.

**27** And-I-saw like-[the]-gleam-of amber, like-[the]-appearance-of fire within-it all-around, from-the-appearance-of His-waist and-upward; and-from-the-appearance-of His-waist and-downward I-saw like-[the]-appearance-of fire, and-brightness to-it all-around.

**28** Like-[the]-appearance-of the-bow which is in-the-cloud on-[the]-day-of rain, so [was] the-appearance-of the-brightness all-around — it [was] the-appearance-of [the]-likeness-of [the]-glory-of YHWH. And-I-saw and-I-fell upon my-face, and-I-heard [the]-voice-of [one]-speaking.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **1:1**: Ba-sheloshim shanah — 'in the thirtieth year.' Ambiguous: Ezekiel's age (priestly service begins at 30, Num 4:3) or a calendrical reckoning. The exilic setting by the Chebar canal establishes the displacement context.

- **1:10**: The four faces — adam (human), aryeh (lion), shor (ox), nesher (eagle) — represent the created order: humanity, wild beasts, domesticated animals, birds. These reappear in Rev 4:7.

- **1:16**: Ophan betokh ha-ophan — 'a wheel within a wheel.' The interlocking wheel-mechanism allows omnidirectional movement. The ophannim become an angelic class in later Jewish tradition.

— EMET
